items.title: 2. Energy Imbalance between the Poles and Equator (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 2. Energy Imbalance between the Poles and Equator: a main subheading of 21.11 Global Climate and Energy Transfer from the Sun, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 181-181.

blocks.text: Zameen ka climate system basically (asal mein) is baat se banta hai ke Sooraj ki energy us ki surface par barabar nahi phailti. Equator par dhoop seedhi aur tez parti hai; wahan garam hawa oopar uth kar low-pressure (kam dabao wale) areas banati hai. Poles par dhoop tirchi aur kamzor parti hai; wahan thandi hawa neeche baithti hai aur high-pressure (zyada dabao wale) areas bante hain. Energy ka yeh imbalance duniya bhar ki atmospheric circulation (hawa ka ghoomna) chalata hai aur hawa ke patterns banata hai: equator ke qareeb trade winds, mid-latitudes (beech wali latitudes) mein westerlies, aur poles ke qareeb polar easterlies. Yeh hawayein ocean currents ke saath mil kar duniya bhar mein garmi dobara phailati hain. Lekin insanon ki chhori hui greenhouse gases is natural balance ko bigar rahi hain, jis se global warming barh rahi hai aur mausam ke patterns badal rahe hain. Figure 21.13 zameen ka yeh energy imbalance dikhata hai: equator ko seedhi dhoop milti hai aur poles ko tirchi (oblique, angle par), jis se garmi barabar nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Sooraj se parallel Sun's rays aik jhuki hui zameen par aati hain jis ke gird patli atmosphere hai. Beech wali ray par 'Sunlight Strikes Most Directly', oopar neeche wali par 'Low Angle of Incoming Sunlight'. Latitude lines: Arctic Circle, 60 degree N, 30 degree N, Tropic of Cancer, Equator, Tropic of Capricorn, 30 degree S, 60 degree S, Antarctic Circle; North Pole aur South Pole.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.13: poles aur equator ke darmiyan energy imbalance (kitab ki Figure 21.13 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Equator ke qareeb dhoop seedhi parti hai, is liye utni hi roshni chhote area par girti hai aur zyada garmi deti hai. Poles ke qareeb roshni tirchi (low angle) aati hai aur bare area par phail jati hai. Kaali lines 30 aur 60 degree latitude hain; safed dashed lines Tropic of Cancer/Capricorn (23.5 degree) aur Arctic/Antarctic Circle (66.5 degree) hain. Kitab do do labels aik saath likhti hai (maslan '30°N' aur 'Tropic of Cancer'), lekin yeh do alag lines hain.

blocks.prompt: Equator ko poles se har square metre par zyada Sooraj ki energy kyun milti hai?
blocks.explanation: Equator par dhoop taqreeban seedhi parti hai, is liye roshni chhote area par jama hoti hai. Poles par kam angle se parti hai, is liye wahi roshni kaheen bare area par phail jati hai (aur zyada atmosphere se bhi guzarti hai).

items: Energy budget: absorb ki hui dhoop = space mein jane wali infrared; balance ho to temperature steady.
Barf dhoop reflect karti hai; pighalti barf se aur garmi; greenhouse gases infrared trap karti hain (global warming).
Equator garam, poles thande: is farq se hawa chalti hai (trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies).
